analysis: BQ4 PM4Py resource and supplier analysis

definitions.resource_workload: Number of unique events in which a Resource object participates.
definitions.resource_workload_share_denominator: Sum of unique event participations across all Resource objects.
definitions.resource_coverage: Unique business objects associated with a Resource through shared events, divided by the total number of objects of that type.
definitions.supplier_participation: Number of unique 'Obtain Quotations' events in which the Supplier is related with qualifier 'queried supplier'.
definitions.supplier_selection: Number of unique 'Evaluate And Select Quotation' events in which the Supplier is related with qualifier 'selected supplier'.
definitions.supplier_selection_rate: Number of quotation procedures in which a supplier was selected, divided by the total number of quotation procedures (Obtain Quotations events).
definitions.supplier_concentration_hhi: Sum of squared supplier selection shares; used descriptively.
definitions.supplier_dependency: Unique Order objects associated with each Supplier divided by the total number of Order objects; supplementary metric.
